name: Nuuk (Greenland)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the arms of Nuuk: a shield showing the red seminary building and a kayak paddle above waves, beneath Mount Sermitsiaq.
history: The arms, by Ejner Heilmann and Sven Tito Achen, were adopted in 1986 and show the old seminary of Nuuk, a kayak paddle and the mountain Sermitsiaq; the town flies them on a plain white flag.

features.role: arms of Nuuk with seminary, paddle, waves and Sermitsiaq
